title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Nikah 2260 views Q. My sister gets dreams of her marriage repeatedly.she is nineteen years old and not yet married. She gets this dreams early mornings. What does it mean. 3236 views Q. Validity of nikah. 3387 views Q. Clarification on marriage rules 5832 views Q. Is it allowed to love a girl before marriage? 3904 views Q. How do I look after my mother & wife simultaneously if they have a misunderstanding and my wife is not ready to stay with my mother? 2807 views Q. In continuation with Question #: 16005 Respected Maulana, Assalamualiakum Wa rahamatullahi barkatahu, I am in very great trouble now. The girl whom I got married is having an affair with someone. Due to this she had asked me many times to give talaq. Since I did not knew that she loves someone I had ignored this. She has clearly written in one letter and also told me about this later. I did not share this (she loves someone else and talaq matter) with her parents. Few days before she went to her sister?s house and said to her parents that I have given talaq to her 3 to 4 times. Those people came to my house and beat me and blamed my sister that she has spoiled their daughter?s life. She lie a lot (even takes oath on Quran). While getting married I was told my many people who know her family that they strictly follow Islam. But now I know that they are not. Her father had died few years back before my marriage. She has taken all jewelry give by us. I do not want to spend rest of my life with a liar who does not fear Allah and the Day of Judgment. Please help me. In eleven months of our marriage she hardly stayed with me for 2 months. Please let me know what will be compensation I should give? Will I get back the jewelry (not mahar) give by me? Are there any other chargers (extra money) applicable? Allah knows better, Thanks in advance Regards! 2386 views Q. can husband and wife can suck/kiss each others fingers of feet,legs except surrouning area of vagina. please let me know is there any authentic hadith to know more details.
